proves.claim: On a board whose baseline upload is paused, relay on exits 0 and status then shows no relay.excluded.

cli.journeys-relay-exclusion.relay-on-cl.why: Without it, a paused baseline could keep a board excluded after the person ran relay on.

proves.claim: A plain relay off then relay on on an unpaused board still ends with no relay.excluded.

cli.journeys-relay-exclusion.relay-off-t.why: Without it, a paused baseline could keep a board excluded after the person ran relay on.
